newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian plane crash death toll reaches 30.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian plane crash death toll reaches 30.

text.p: The death toll in the crash of a Fokker F-27 aircraft near the Indonesian city of Bandung last week rose to 30 on Sunday after another passenger died in hospital, the official Antara news agency reported.
It said Indonesian Palal Santosa died in Bandung's Santo Borromeus hospital on Sunday morning, almost three days after the crash of the Sempati Air plane.
Airline officials had earlier put the death toll at 29 of the 50 people aboard the plane chartered from local company PT Trigana Air Service.

Three residents of a housing estate were injured when the plane clipped the roof of their house moments before crashing into a field while attempting an emergency landing at a military air base at about midday on Thursday.
The cause of the accident is still being investigated.
Officials have said the pilot had radioed to Bandung's main airport shortly after take-off that one engine had stopped and he had requested permission to land.
